fact: The Instruction Set Architecture is the core of computer architecture and acts as the interface between hardware and software

The ISA defines the set of instructions a processor can execute, the instruction formats such as ADD, LOAD and STORE, the data types such as integer and floating point, the registers available, and the addressing modes
Applications compiled for a specific ISA, such as x86 or ARM, will only run on processors supporting that ISA, which is why mobile apps are built for the ARM-based processors in smartphones
An operating system is designed for a specific ISA, for example Windows is optimized for x86 architecture systems
Different organizations, that is different hardware implementations, can support the same ISA but vary in performance
